# The sitemap tile shows real links

## Context

The sitemap component has a tile in the examples catalog (record `sitemap`, family `platform`, added with #21333). The band's rows asked for more than the tile: "tile with real links. It is a component, so its home is More components: that lane's call." A row-by-row sweep of #21140's target on 22 Nov found the example unchanged and no leaf.

## The Problem

`examples/sitemap/MainContainer.mjs:48` fills the component with "Group 1", "Item 1", "Group 2". A visitor who opens the tile sees a list of placeholders and cannot tell what a sitemap component is for. It also sits in Workers & Platform, a group about threads and service workers, where nobody looks for a component.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/sitemap/MainContainer.mjs`: unchanged since 2024.
- The record `sitemap`: `kind: 'component'`, family `platform`.

## The Fix

Fill the example with a real structure: the Portal's own sections and a few of their pages, with links that go somewhere. Move the record's home to More components, where the other component tiles are. Retake the tile's crop.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The tile's stage shows real group names and items, and at least the first level of links navigates.
- [ ] The record's family is `components`, and Workers & Platform no longer lists it.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844.
- [ ] The tile's crop is retaken (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the stage at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Changes to the sitemap component.
